America is at war with us, but their war weariness is extremely high (56% for us, 27% for them). While their ideological difference is massive, we maintain a slightly cautious relationship of 15/10 to leave the door open for peace if their war weariness eventually forces them to capitulate.

The Inca are our primary competitor and we are at war. However, we are only 2 turns away from becoming Influential with them to secure the final piece of our cultural victory. Maintaining a neutral/guarded posture of 10/5 ensures we do not needlessly escalate or provoke them as we close the gap.

Morocco nuked Calixtlahuaca on Turn 419, demonstrating extreme hostility. We drastically lower our stance with them to 10/5 to reflect their aggressive nuclear actions while keeping our defense systems prioritized against their units.

Ethiopia is a vassal of the Inca and at war with us. We reduce our stance to 30/25 to align with the active war state, but keep a slightly positive bias in case their vassalage breaks, allowing for separate peace negotiations.

The Internet is the next logical step after Satellites. It provides a massive +50% Tourism boost to all cities, cementing our Cultural Victory, while unlocking key endgame technologies (Nanotechnology, Particle Physics, Globalization) on the path to Future Tech for the Citizen Earth Protocol.

Great Leap Forward is an Order Level 2 Tenet that provides a free technology. This is critical to skip a costly late-game tech and accelerate our path to Future Tech and the Citizen Earth Protocol, saving us 10+ turns of research.
